references.text: Some doubted when they saw him, which refers to the disciples' doubt and uncertainty even after Jesus' resurrection, similar to their reaction in Mark.
The apostles' doubt and skepticism when the women told them about Jesus' resurrection mirrors the disciples' doubt in Mark.
The disciples' fear and doubt when Jesus stands among them after the resurrection highlights their difficulty believing in Jesus' resurrection.
The story of Thomas's doubt and how he came to believe after seeing and touching Jesus' wounds illustrates the disciples' doubt and how they overcame it.
